additional_info.subject: Rollback to v4.0.11
additional_info.body:
Dear Support, good morning.
We are required to update back the FW update for charging stations.
We will have to plan it according to a schedule if it is possible for the night hours in Israel and be updated when each charging station is updated, also to be in contact with the customers.
Our priority is at night so that the customers do not feel anything during the day.
I would like two more questions:
How long did the update per charging station take?
What is the estimated SIM consumption for the update? (In Israel this is important for us to know because we work on the customers' local SIMs)
I am attaching a list of charging stations with serial numbers for the purpose of updating back.
